baseline_case: C17 Cristina Narbona Ruiz conflicting public DOB assertions 1951-07-21 vs 1951-07-29

execution.environment: Local staged exact module and tests, not full clean GitHub checkout or CI; results reproduced before commits

method: Maintain original publisher family and document-level provenance, do not count two copied documents of same issuer as independent attestations of birth certificate; validate schema, ISO dates and unique source-ref, fail closed on malformed inputs.
limits: Issuer family grouping is a heuristic, not cryptographically established editorial independence; model cannot establish actual legal date of birth.
Five documents refer to same public political career; their DOB conflict does not prove two persons, nor adjudicate correct date.
Module is not integrated with server HTTP, source ingestion, permission review or production scoring.
This local correctness result is not a new scientific N1–N3 finding.
ABP: Audit trail and conflict reporting only
R5: Preserve two authorized cycles unless new independent contradictory individual evidence, dated source snapshot or clean integration can discriminate; not spend on repetitive name normalization.
